The '''wedding gown''' was worn by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] at her [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|secret wedding]] to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] at [[Varykino Villa/Legends|Varykino Villa]].<ref name="Episode II" />

The gown was [[Color/Legends|white]], with intricate, off-white scrollery done in [[Ribbon/Legends|ribbon]] throughout and made of lace and beads. The sleeves reached to her elbows, and was hemmed with scalloped lace. Her arms were decorated with scrollery. The headpiece was made of lace, with a band decorated with swirl scrollery. The veil hung down to her mid back, and [[Pearl/Legends|pearls]] studded the entire wedding gown. She wore her [[hair]] down as she bound her decision to pursue her love rather than deny it.<ref name="Episode II" />
